item.title: 8 Ways Climate Change Affects Health — and How to Protect Yourself
item.description: Learn about the main risks climate change poses, including those related to the heart and lungs, with strategies for minimizing the impact on your own health.

item.title: 9 Psoriasis ‘Mistakes’ and How to Avoid Them
item.description: Key missteps in managing psoriasis include delaying treatment and neglecting skin care. Follow expert tips for keeping your skin healthy and managing flare-ups effectively.

item.title: How to Tell Your Partner You Have Genital Herpes
item.description: Discover how to communicate with partners and enjoy a healthy sex life with herpes. Learn about prevention, disclosure, and staying intimate post-diagnosis.

item.title: The Surprising Link Between Psoriasis and High Blood Pressure
item.description: High blood pressure and psoriasis are connected. Learn why high blood pressure and skin symptoms go hand in hand, and what to do if you are affected.

item.title: Pancreatitis Symptoms
item.description: Pain in the upper abdomen is the most common symptom of both acute and chronic pancreatitis. Early detection can prevent severe complications. See a doctor if you experience sudden, severe abdominal pain.

item.title: LARS: The Colorectal Cancer Surgery Side Effect No One Talks About
item.description: Low anterior resection syndrome (LARS) is a common side effect of colorectal cancer surgery. Learn how to improve symptoms and quality of life with available treatment options and community support.

item.title: 5 Potential Benefits of Drinking Baking Soda
item.description: Drinking baking soda water may help with heartburn, indigestion, and athletic performance, but it comes with risks. Learn about the evidence, safe dosages, and who should avoid it.

item.title: GLP-1 Drugs Linked to Osteoporosis and Gout
item.description: People on GLP-1s had slightly higher risks of osteoporosis and gout than similar people not taking these drugs. But diet and exercise could reduce these risks.

item.title: Genital Herpes Causes: HSV-1 and HSV-2
item.description: While genital herpes is usually associated with herpes simplex 2 (HSV-2), it can also be caused by herpes simplex 1 (HSV-1). HSV-2 is more likely to cause symptoms and to be transmitted during sex. A DNA test can determine which virus a person has.

item.title: What Is Depression (Major Depressive Disorder, or MDD)?
item.description: Learn how to recognize the warning signs and symptoms of clinical depression and how to treat it.
